1 (Currently amended): A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and the third member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, wherein the layer of adhesive comprises a thermosetting resin.

2 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, and the layer of adhesive includes a folded sheet of structural adhesive.

5 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, and the layer of adhesive comprises a thermosetting resin.

6 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, and the layer of adhesive comprises a thermosetting resin.

11 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the filler is one of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member.

13 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, and the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges.

25 (Currently amended): A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape plies in an area between the web and the flanges; the structure including radius areas between the web and the flanges and a cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone.
